CPDataKit v0.8.0 adds selective multidimensional reads, scientific heatmaps, schema drafting,
mapping previews and reproducible batch conversion. It also includes the attributed
KupferDigital/FE example with 483 experiment-derived and 729 training records.

The dependency jobs now install exact Python-specific lower combinations or latest compatible
versions, build a wheel from its sdist, and run the sdist tests against a clean wheel installation.
The h5py, Pint and netCDF4 floors exclude reproduced import and classic NetCDF failures.

Python >=3.12, v0.5 public API/CLI, schema 1.0 and default tabular HDF5 1.0 remain supported.
Code uses Apache-2.0; the reference materials retain CC-BY-4.0 attribution and source hashes.

Validation: eight local Windows/WSL Linux combinations passed 563 tests each with 87.44%
coverage, clean wheel installs, dependency probes and real Uvicorn/static smoke. Edge heatmap
and draft interactions passed at desktop and 390px widths. Browser fixture upload used the
application API because the extension blocked file selection. macOS and hosted CI remain pending.
Exact results and artifact hashes are in docs/verification/2026-09-08-v080-p0.md.
Release metadata is synchronized to 0.8.0 with the release date 2026-09-08.
